title: Environment, Health & Safety
headline: Clean by design, safe by physics.
tagline: The Kronos environment, health, and safety case — low-neutron, meltdown-proof, no long-lived waste, and almost no water — plus one honest look at the world fusion makes possible.

the-safety-case: Cannot melt down, cannot run away — passive safety by physics.
low-neutron-and-waste: Low activation, favorable waste class, no long-lived spent fuel.
water-land-resources: Minimal water via direct energy conversion; a small footprint.
fusion-vs-alternatives: Clean, firm power that complements renewables.
fuel-and-sustainability: Abundant deuterium, bred helium-3, no mining.
the-vision: One page: the advanced society on a healed planet.
